Resolve template to layers

Source: R/gq_groups.R
gq_template_layers.Rd

Expands a template through its groups to produce a flat data.frame of every layer needed for that project type. Joins with the style registry to include source_layer and type.

Usage

gq_template_layers(template, registry = NULL)

Arguments

template

Character. Template name (e.g., "bcfishpass_mobile").

registry

Optional registry list (from gq_reg_main()). If NULL, loads via gq_reg_main().

Value

A data.frame with columns: template, group, group_order, subgroup, layer_key, order, source_layer, source_type, type.

Examples

gq_template_layers("bcfishpass_mobile")
